question: 统计各品牌下'家用电器'类在售商品的标价中位数（保留2位小数）和成本价中位数（保留2位小数），仅展示商品数不少于3款的品牌，按标价中位数降序排列，返回品牌、标价中位数、成本价中位数三列，最多100行。 以上排序相同时，再按品牌升序。
off_sql: WITH ranked_prices AS (SELECT brand, list_price, cost_price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY brand ORDER BY list_price) AS rn_list, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY brand ORDER BY cost_price) AS rn_cost, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY brand) AS cnt FROM products WHERE category = '家用电器' AND is_active = 1), medians AS (SELECT brand, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN rn_list IN (FLOOR((cnt + 1) / 2), CEIL((cnt + 1) / 2)) THEN list_price END), 2) AS list_price_median, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN rn_cost IN (FLOOR((cnt + 1) / 2), CEIL((cnt + 1) / 2)) THEN cost_price END), 2) AS cost_price_median FROM ranked_prices GROUP BY brand, cnt HAVING cnt >= 3) SELECT brand, list_price_median, cost_price_median FROM medians ORDER BY list_price_median DESC, brand ASC LIMIT 100

('alipay', 'wechat', 'card') THEN CONCAT(o.user_id, '-', o.payment_method) END), 0) AS distinct_user_payment_combos, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.payment_method IN ('alipay', 'wechat', 'card') THEN o.user_id END), 0) AS users_with_any_main_payment, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM orders WHERE payment_method = 'alipay' AND order_status IN ('paid', payment_method = 'card' AND order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped')) THEN o.user_id END), 0) AS users_with_all_three_payments FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON u.user_id = o.user_id AND o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped') GROUP BY u.gender), user_payment_counts AS (SELECT u.gender, u.user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.payment_method IN ('alipay', 'wechat', 'card') THEN o.payment_method END) AS payment_method_count FROM users AS u LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON u.user_id = o.user_id AND o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped') GROUP BY u.gender, u.user_id), user_payment_summary AS (SELECT gender, COUNT(*) AS user_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN payment_method_count = 3 THEN 1 END) AS users_with_all_three FROM user_payment_counts GROUP BY gender) SELECT gs.gender, ROUND(COALESCE(gs.total_valid_orders * 1.0 / gs.total_users, 0), 4) AS avg_order_count, ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT AVG(payment_method_count) FROM user_payment_counts AS upc WHERE upc.gender = gs.gender), 0), 4) AS avg_payment_method_count, ROUND(COALESCE((SELECT CAST(users_with_all_three AS DECIMAL) / user_count FROM user_payment_summary AS ups WHERE ups.gender = gs.gender), 0), 4) AS question: 请列出所有品牌与品类组合中，其在售商品的销量集中度（定义为：销量TOP3商品的销量之和 / 该组合全部商品销量总和，保留4位小数），仅展示销量总和不低于1000件的组合，按集中度升序排列，最多返回100行。 主排序值相同时，再按品牌、品类升序。
off_sql: WITH brand_category_sales AS (SELECT p.brand, p.category, p.product_id, COALESCE(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS total_quantity FROM products AS p LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE p.is_active = 1 AND (o.order_status IS NULL OR o.order_status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped')) GROUP BY p.brand, p.category, p.product_id), brand_category_agg AS (SELECT brand, category, SUM(total_quantity) AS total_brand_category_quantity FROM brand_category_sales GROUP BY brand, category HAVING SUM(total_quantity) >= 1000), ranked_products AS (SELECT bcs.brand, bcs.category, bcs.product_id, bcs.total_quantity, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bcs.brand, bcs.category ORDER BY bcs.total_quantity DESC) AS rn FROM brand_category_sales AS bcs INNER JOIN brand_category_agg AS bca ON bcs.brand = bca.brand AND bcs.category = bca.category), top3_sum AS (SELECT rp.brand, rp.category, SUM(rp.total_quantity) AS top3_quantity_sum FROM ranked_products AS rp WHERE rp.rn <= 3 GROUP BY rp.brand, rp.category) SELECT bca.brand, bca.category, ROUND(COALESCE(t3.top3_quantity_sum, 0) * 1.0 / bca.total_brand_category_quantity, 4) AS concentration FROM brand_category_agg AS bca LEFT JOIN top3_sum AS t3 ON bca.brand = t3.brand AND bca.category = t3.category ORDER BY concentration ASC, bca.brand ASC, bca.category ASC LIMIT 100
